title: Making music together
examples: Can we make a beat like a drum?
What is the difference between singing and playing an instrument?
How do we keep the beat when we sing?

explain.say: Today we will learn about making music together.
Some things we use to make music are called instruments.
Rhythm is the beat or the steady beat in music.
Singing uses your voice to make lovely sounds for music.
We can use all three things together to make music.
When we march, we use rhythm with our feet and maybe a drum.

faq.q: What is the difference between rhythm and singing?
faq.a: Rhythm is about the beat you keep with your body or an instrument. Singing is using your voice to make sounds.

faq.q: Can I make music without any instruments?
faq.a: Yes, you can use your body, like clapping or stomping your feet. Your body is a fun instrument.
asks: Do I need real things to make music?

faq.q: How do I keep the beat when I sing?
faq.a: Try to tap your foot or clap softly while you sing the song. This helps your body feel the steady beat.
asks: Should I move when I sing?
How do I stay on time?

faq.a: No, some instruments are blown, like a flute. Others are plucked, like a guitar string.
asks: Do I only hit things to play music?
What kind of instruments are there?

faq.q: Can we make a pattern with sounds?
faq.a: Yes, you can make a pattern by repeating sounds, like clap, clap, stomp, clap, clap, stomp.

facts: Drums are instruments that are often hit to make a steady beat.
Rhythm is the pattern of sounds and silences in music.
Singing uses your breath and your voice box to create sound.
You can use your hands and feet to keep a strong rhythm.

quiz.say: If you clap your hands in a steady beat, you are showing:
quiz.why: Clapping keeps a steady beat, which is what rhythm means.

wrong.0: Instruments are things you play, not the action of beating.
wrong.1: Singing uses your voice, not your hands.
wrong.2: Sound is what you hear, not the pattern itself.

quiz.say: Which part of making music uses your voice?
quiz.why: Singing is the act of making music with your voice.

wrong.0: Drums are physical objects used to make noise.
wrong.1: Clapping is a body action, not the act of singing.
wrong.2: The beat is the steady pulse, not the action itself.

quiz.say: When you play a guitar, you are using:
quiz.why: A guitar is a physical object that helps you make music.

wrong.0: Rhythm is the beat, not the object.
wrong.1: Singing is using your voice, not a tool.
wrong.2: Your voice is for singing, not for playing an instrument.
